description:
[FREE] Settlement Assurance from the AgentPay x402 facilitator: opt-in
settlement-failure insurance for x402 resource providers. Terms (live from
the pool endpoint): 0.1% premium per settled amount charged to the enrolled
resource, claims for facilitator-side settle failures filed within 72
hours, verified claims pay up to 25 USDC on Base from the shared pool.
Enroll: POST https://x402-agent-pay.com/facilitator/insurance/enroll
with {resource, wallet, contact}. Claim: POST .../insurance/claim with the
settlement receipt and failure proof. Human page:
https://x402-agent-pay.com/assurance/
Pass resource= to see whether a specific resource is enrolled.
name: settlement_assurance_info
